info.name: OMS API Collection
info.description:
Postman Collection for OMS (Order Management System) API

## Base URL
All endpoints are prefixed with `{{baseUrl}}` (default: `http://localhost:8080`).

## Authentication
1. Call `POST /api/v1/auth/login` to obtain `accessToken` and `refreshToken`.
2. The `accessToken` is automatically attached to subsequent requests via the pre-request script.
3. When the `accessToken` expires, use `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` to obtain a new token pair.

## Collection Variables
- `productId` — ID of the last created/updated product
- `orderId` — ID of the last created order
- `orderNumber` — order number of the last created order

## Environment Variables
- `{{baseUrl}}` — API base URL
- `{{accessToken}}` — JWT Bearer token for authenticated requests
- `{{refreshToken}}` — JWT token used to obtain a new access token

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints for login, token refresh, and logout.

## Flow
1. Login → obtain `accessToken` and `refreshToken`
2. Use `accessToken` in Bearer Authorization header
3. When expired → `refresh` endpoint to get new tokens
4. Logout → blacklists the current access token

item.name: Product
item.description:
Product management endpoints for CRUD operations and search.

## Roles
- **ADMIN**: Can create, update, delete products
- **CUSTOMER**: Can view products only

## Collection Variables
